primitive_contract:
/-- The reference geometry used by the nonlinear estimates, retained on the
same data as the controls and material weights. These are primitive support,
placement and nondegeneracy assertions, not tame conclusions. -/
def N01PrimitiveGeometry (D : ReferenceData) (T : MaterialData)
    (S : PhysicalSpacesData) (C : NonlinearGeometryData S) : Prop :=
  (∀ m, Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ⊆ D.cells (C.cell m)) ∧
  tsupport D.chi ⊆ Ioo D.a D.b ∧
  ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ m r,
    r ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) →
      K⁻¹ * T.E0 (T.sample (C.cell m)) ^ (-K) *
          min (r - C.left m) (C.right m - r) ≤
        -deriv D.w r / (r * D.w r)
final_flow_source:
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.N01cOrdinaryFlowBounds

/-!
# N01c: variations of the ordinary flows

The actual angular and radial variations satisfy their estimates on one
common neighborhood. The coefficient estimate and the geometric clauses
restrict to that same neighborhood, yielding the complete N01 package.
-/

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Blueprint

open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements

theorem N01cFlows (hSpeeds : N01SpeedStatement) : N01Statement := by
  obtain ⟨A, T, S, C, base, loss, ε, hT, hS, hA, hε, hB,
    hCoefficients, hSpeed, hG, hE⟩ := hSpeeds
  obtain ⟨base', ε', hb, hε', hε'ε, hFlows⟩ :=
    n01_exists_ordinaryFlowFamilyTameBounds hS hT hA hε hB hG hE hSpeed
  exact ⟨A, T, S, C, base', loss, ε', hT, hS,
    n01Properties_of_parts hA hε' (n01PartB_mono hB hb hε'ε)
      (coefficientFamilyTameBounds_mono_of_accumulatingProfile hT hA.1.1
        hCoefficients hb le_rfl hε'ε) hFlows⟩

end ContinuousFlexibility.Blueprint
findings: PR23 now proves actual designated-cell containment and a common pointwise optical lower bound on the retained N01a construction and carries N01PrimitiveGeometry through N01a/N01b and intermediate coefficient/speed stages.

The exact final N01cFlows destructs hG and uses it to construct hFlows. It then returns n01Properties_of_parts with hA, restricted hB, coefficient bounds and hFlows; hG is not retained in the final N01Statement.

The fetched Nonlinear.lean has no occurrence of N01PrimitiveGeometry. N01Properties ends with CoefficientFamilyTameBounds and OrdinaryFlowFamilyTameBounds; Through01 is exactly N01Properties and N01Statement returns only Through01 alongside material/space certificates.

The optical lower bound and containing-cell statement cannot therefore be obtained by a projection from arbitrary current Through03. This is an exact interface finding, not a proof that those statements are logically underivable from all other hypotheses.
The already reviewed retained-positive-endpoint theorem concerns the same explicit P/Gamma/profile/retained-coordinates witness. It does not replace an arbitrary Through03 reference.

Have the final N01 package retain that predicate and pass the existing hG through n01Properties_of_parts/N01cFlows; preserve it in neighborhood restriction and cumulative Through02/Through03 construction.
